thread:
incident-bot: PAGER (PD#9876) - GPU capacity alarms: inference-prod queue growth + autoscaler failures in us-west-2. Triggered 2026-03-15T02:14:00Z

emma: Noted. Dashboard shows queue 14k, 95th token latency climbing. Who's on GPU oncall?

raj: I'm on. Pulling autoscaler logs now. Seeing repeated create errors: "InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound" and "AccessDenied: instance-profile not authorized"

sara: Pasting snippets: 
```
E 02:12:11 autoscaler: failed to create instance: InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound
E 02:12:11 aws-sdk: AccessDenied: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-node-profile is not authorized to be used with the launch template
```

dmitri: That smells like a rollout where a new launch template references a non-existent instance profile or IAM role rotation. Any infra deploys recently?

kai: Deploy bot shows LT v4 pushed yesterday which references instance-profile redwood-gpu-node-profile-v2

emma: So autoscaler may be trying to launch using LT v4 but ASG/ASG config might be pointing to v3 or the profile doesn't exist in account. Scale up is blocked -> customer impact. Need mitigation ASAP.

ops-bot: Auto-mitigation suggestions: 1) route non-critical traffic to cpu-inference cluster 2) throttle public batch endpoints 3) manual ASG update to fallback LT version 4) spin up fallback gpu-burst pool (different launch template)

raj: Attempting ASG update to LT v4: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-asg --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc,Version=4` \u2014 getting AccessDenied from our CI role (scoped down)

sara: IAM update required, paging infra-admin oncall.

incident-bot: Infra-admin pager triggered (PD#3452)

emma: While infra-user joins, can we do quick routing so enterprise tenants keep SLO? Prioritize critical API keys.

dmitri: I'll flip routing for non-enterprise API keys to cpu cluster and mark them best-effort. This will preserve capacity for paid customers.

kai: Applying temporary rate limits on public batch endpoints: `rate-limit: 80%` for public keys.

sara: infra-admin (maria) joined the thread.

maria: I see the LT v4 references instance-profile v2 which wasn't created in this account due to an oversight in the rollout. Two options: create the instance-profile quickly or point ASG back to LT v3. Which will restore capacity faster?

emma: Reverting ASG to LT v3 is faster and lower risk right now. Maria, can you update ASG to Version=3?

maria: Running update: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-asg --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc,Version=3` (submitted). Propagation ~30s-2m.

ops-bot: ASG update accepted. Monitoring events.

raj: Autoscaler logs now: `Instance launch initiated` at 02:22:08. Creating nodes...

sara: Kube events show nodes registering, but pods not scheduling. New nodes show taint `worker=dedicated:NoSchedule` while our GPU pods expect taint `gpu=true:NoSchedule` (mismatch). Bootstrap user-data differs between LT versions.

dmitri: Bootstrap script drift. New LT's cloud-init sets different taints/labels. Quick fix: patch inference workload to tolerate the new taint so pods land. Long-term: unify user-data.

kai: We can patch only inference-prod workloads to add toleration — limits blast radius. I'll prepare kubectl patch.

emma: Ensure we don't accidentally schedule non-inference workloads on GPU nodes. Keep toleration scoped.

sara: Applying patch: 
```
kubectl -n inference-prod patch deployment inference-worker --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"worker","operator":"Equal","value":"dedicated","effect":"NoSchedule"}]}}}}'
```

ops-bot: Patch applied. Rolling update started.

raj: Pods are scheduling on new nodes. Token throughput increasing, queue dropping from 14k -> 5.2k within 6m.

maria: I'll follow up to either create the missing instance-profile v2 or update the LT to reference the account-local profile consistently. We'll create a ticket for guardrails.

dmitri: Action items: 1) revert tolerations after nodes have correct labels 2) unify bootstrap user-data across LT versions 3) add autoscaler preflight check to validate LT->instance-profile mapping before scale attempts

kai: Drafted customer comms: short outage window, mitigation executed, next steps + postmortem. I can share with CS for review.

sara: Additional note: GPU spot pools at 95% capacity. Consider bursting to reserved pool or spinning fallback dedicated pool if cold starts acceptable.

emma: Customer impact summary: ~28 minutes degraded throughput. Enterprise customers saw ~30-40% increased latency; some public/low-priority keys experienced 429s. No full priority tenant outages. Recommend notifying CS/product.

incident-bot: Incident #9876 -> mitigated -> monitoring. Duration reported: 00:48:47. Postmortem requested.

emma: Downgrade severity P1 -> P2 (partial degradation, mitigation successful). Assign postmortem to dmitri + maria. CC: product, sales.

maria: Created ticket INFRA-892 (LaunchTemplate/InstanceProfile guardrails + automation). ETA 72h for initial fix.

dmitri: I'll draft the timeline and include commands/log snippets we used. Also propose an automated ASG health-check to validate taints/labels within 5m of node join.

kai: Runbook note: Add check when LT changed: `aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --launch-template-ids lt-0abc --query 'LaunchTemplates[0].LatestVersionNumber'` compare to ASG version and alert on mismatch. Automation recommended.

sara: Queue at 600, priority latency back within SLO. Marking incident closed from oncall POV.

emma: Thanks all. Postmortem in 24h. :thumbsup:
